timeline.title: A question about people
timeline.copy: Graduate research on what customers value — location, price, facilities, ambiance — later shapes the business plan.

timeline.title: Finding the place
timeline.copy: Locations are compared and surveys run on pricing, facilities, ambiance, and experience. The concept takes shape with architects and builders.

timeline.title: Doors open in Ecoland
timeline.copy: Space Arabica opens on Ecowest Drive: good coffee, shared tables, fast Wi-Fi, and a mini conference room.

timeline.title: Still evolving
timeline.copy: Nine signature episodes and counting, two bookable spaces, and a team trained in-house.

space_inclusions: Food and drinks, fully consumable during your session
space_policies: A 50% down payment confirms your reservation.
Consumables are for food and drinks during your reserved session only.
Unused consumables are non-refundable, cannot be converted to cash, and cannot be used after the session.
The full reservation fee applies whether or not the consumable amount is used.
